WoW: Forever

Arms Warrior

Two-handed burst with bleeds and a 50% healing debuff. At level 20 both published Arms builds spend all eleven of their points in the Fury tree. Arms' own engine sits at level 30 and beyond.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Arms build has been tested by anyone. Talent tiers unlock at fixed levels: tier 1 at 10, then 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, and the capstone at 40. No source has posted a level 30 build either. The cap only reached 30 on October 1, and none of the three has published one since. The level 30 line below therefore extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs; it is not a build any guide has recommended. Blizzard's own caveat: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

What Arms is for

Bleeds and burst out of one heavy weapon, plus a 50% healing debuff. Its engine is Rend into BloodthrillBloodthrillTalentCastInstantRange50000 yd rangeDuration6 secYour Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend have a 15% chance to allow the use of your Overpower ability on the target. Lasts 6 sec. into OverpowerOverpowerLevel 12 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost50 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownInstantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 5. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried., which is tier 5 and so level 30 at the earliest. Mortal StrikeMortal StrikeLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost300 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 secA vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec. arrives at level 40.

That is why the published level-20 build spends all eleven points in the Fury tree: nothing in Arms is worth reaching yet.

Icy Veins rates Warrior a poor leveller, one of the more difficult classes, "especially when gear falls behind." It scores Arms 2.0/5 for Levelling on the Level 20 toolkit. Neither Wowhead nor ClassicWoW.gg publishes a levelling score for the spec.

Your talent points

Level 20: 0/11/0, entirely in Fury. Not a typo: it is what both published Arms builds do.

  1. CrueltyCrueltyTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%., 5 points
  2. Unbridled WrathUnbridled WrathTalentCastInstant, 5 points — it no longer grants its old +2-rage-per-proc bonus for two-handed weapons, which used to be the reason an Arms Warrior took it. The published builds pre-date that change and so does the game: the tooltip in front of you still shows the doubling, so take this from Blizzard's October 1 notes rather than from the talent. Even so, nothing else in Fury row 1 is worth taking instead
  3. Piercing HowlPiercing HowlTalentCastInstantCost100 ManaDuration6 secCauses all nearby enemies to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec., 1 point

If you would rather commit to Arms early at 20 — our own extension, not a published build: Improved Heroic StrikeImproved Heroic StrikeTalentCastInstantReduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 1 Rage. 3, Improved RendImproved RendTalentCastInstantIncreases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 15%. 3, Improved ChargeImproved ChargeTalentCastInstantIncreases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 3. 2, Improved OverpowerImproved OverpowerTalent · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%. 2, then 1 point into Deep WoundsDeep WoundsTalentCastInstant. Improved Rend is forced here: it is Deep Wounds' prerequisite.

Multi-target: don't. Kill one fast and CleaveCleaveLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost200 ManaRangeMeleeA sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 5 to the target and a second nearby enemy. once or twice as rage allows. Will affect up to 4 targets. and Demoralizing ShoutDemoralizing ShoutSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost100 ManaDuration30 secReduces the melee attack power of nearby enemies by 10 for 30 sec. are damage reduction here, not damage. With a healer, pull two for the extra rage from damage taken.

Arms is the only Warrior spec whose published priority includes SlamSlamLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5Cast1.5 sec castCost150 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown18 sec cooldownSlams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16.. Steps 1 to 7 are Fury's seven abilities in the same order, worded a little differently.

Stat priority

Weapon damage, then Hit, critical strike, Strength, Agility, Stamina. Slow and heavy: rage is normalized to weapon speed, and SlamSlamLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5Cast1.5 sec castCost150 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown18 sec cooldownSlams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16. and Mortal StrikeMortal StrikeLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost300 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 secA vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec. both take their base from the weapon.

What Forever changed for Arms

  • Improved SlamImproved SlamTalentCastInstantReduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec. moved from Fury into Arms and was cut from 5 ranks to 2. Blizzard's own description: it reduces the cooldown, global cooldown and cast time of SlamSlamLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5Cast1.5 sec castCost150 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown18 sec cooldownSlams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16. together, and stops Slam interrupting your swing timer. That is 1.5/3 seconds off a cooldown now 18 seconds, up from 15. ClassicWoW.gg and Icy Veins have the talent leaving Slam's own cooldown untouched.
  • All four weapon-specialisation talents were deleted and replaced by one WeaponmasterWeaponmasterTalentCastInstantDurationUntil cancelledYour attacks with Maces and Staves ignore 15% of your target's armor.. The Classic mace stun proc is gone, replaced by armour penetration.
  • Two entirely new talents: BloodthrillBloodthrillTalentCastInstantRange50000 yd rangeDuration6 secYour Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend have a 15% chance to allow the use of your Overpower ability on the target. Lasts 6 sec., and Spearing StrikeSpearing StrikeTalentCastInstantCost150 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown20 sec cooldownA brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage, plus an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets.. Spearing Strike is an instant attack for 15 Rage on a 20-second cooldown. It deals a percentage of weapon damage and dismounts the target, and Blizzard says that damage is doubled against a mounted target, a Dragon, or a Giant. It no longer requires a two-handed weapon, but it does now require Battle StanceBattle StanceLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown1 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledA balanced combat stance., so it is unusable in Berserker or Defensive Stance whatever you are holding.
  • Anger ManagementAnger ManagementTalentCastInstantGenerates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%. generates 1 Rage every 3 seconds in combat and cuts your out-of-combat Rage loss by 30%, and that is unchanged from Classic. Blizzard's own notes say only that its tooltip was clarified, with no functionality change. ImpaleImpaleTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%. no longer requires Deep WoundsDeep WoundsTalentCastInstant. Improved RendImproved RendTalentCastInstantIncreases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 15%. was nerfed and Two-Handed Weapon SpecializationTwo-Handed Weapon SpecializationTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%. cut from 5 ranks to 3.
  • Improved Tactical MasteryImproved Tactical MasteryTalentCastInstantTactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances. (formerly just Tactical MasteryTactical MasteryLevel 14 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstant) now retains 3 more Rage per point when you change Stances, to a maximum of 25. That sits on top of the 10 Rage baseline Tactical Mastery trains at level 14 (Blizzard).
  • Improved OverpowerImproved OverpowerTalent · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%. moved from row 3 up to row 2. Iron WillIron WillTalentCastInstantReduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%. is no longer in this tree: it is Protection row 1 now, and that guide covers its Stun and Fear duration effect.

At level 60

Unknown. Nobody has tested whether the Rend, BloodthrillBloodthrillTalentCastInstantRange50000 yd rangeDuration6 secYour Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend have a 15% chance to allow the use of your Overpower ability on the target. Lasts 6 sec. and Improved SlamImproved SlamTalentCastInstantReduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec. package beats a Fury or hybrid split. Gear cannot be planned for either: Forever reworked dungeon loot and item stats wholesale, so Classic equipment lists do not transfer.
